message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown, depending on sweetness |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed or natural |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (5 g) | Works with acidic cocoa |
| Baking powder | 1 tsp (5 g) | Adds lift |
| Salt | ½ tsp (2.5 g) | Balances sweetness |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with buttermilk |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 ml) | Enhances flavor |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, keeps batter moist |
| Optional: buttermilk or sour cream | ½ cup (120 ml) | For extra tenderness |

**Optional extras for richer flavor:**
- ¼ cup (60 ml) espresso or strong coffee (enhances chocolate taste)
- ½ cup (120 ml) melted dark chocolate (adds depth)
- 1 tsp almond or orange extract (subtle twist)

**For frosting (optional):**
- ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
- 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar
- ¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
- ¼–½ cup (60–120 ml) milk or heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your oven size or personal taste. Happy baking!
